description: A close-fitting neoprene wetsuit in scuffed black and hazard-yellow, salvaged and patched at the knees. It zips from tailbone to nape and traps a thin layer of warmth against the skin — the difference between a long cold swim and hypothermia. Cut for the water, clumsy on land.
name: neoprene wetsuit
